definitions.explanation: Having or showing a spirit of rebellion against authority, convention, or established norms. Can describe both serious political rebellion and a personal attitude of nonconformity.

examples.japanese: {反逆的|はんぎゃくてき}な⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
⟦ロック→ロック：08116_rokku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{反逆的|はんぎゃくてき}な⟦エネルギー→エネルギー：03834_enerugii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Rock music has a rebellious energy.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{頃|ころ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧{反逆的|はんぎゃくてき}な⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{崩|くず}さなかった→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧。
examples.english: In his youth, he maintained a rebellious stance toward society.

notes:
A na-adjective formed from {反逆|はんぎゃく} (rebellion; revolt) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧. Carries a stronger connotation than ⟦{反抗的|はんこうてき}→反抗的：21089_hankouteki⟧な — while ⟦{反抗的|はんこうてき}→反抗的：21089_hankouteki⟧ suggests resisting authority, ⟦{反逆的|はんぎゃくてき}→反逆的：25953_hangyakuteki⟧ implies a more fundamental rejection of the established order.

Often used in literary, political, and cultural criticism contexts. Has a somewhat dramatic or romantic nuance, evoking the spirit of revolutionaries, artists, and countercultural movements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {反逆的|はんぎゃくてき}な⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧: rebellious spirit
- {反逆的|はんぎゃくてき}な⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧: rebellious stance
- {反逆的|はんぎゃくてき}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: insubordinate attitude
- {反逆的|はんぎゃくてき}な⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧: insurgent action

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{反抗的|はんこうてき}→反抗的：21089_hankouteki⟧な: defiant; disobedient — milder, focused on resisting specific authority
- ⟦{革命的|かくめいてき}→革命的：06374_kakumeiteki⟧な: revolutionary — emphasizes transformative change
- {反骨|はんこつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: rebellious by nature — literary, describes an innate spirit of defiance
